name: Moons of Peril
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: DPS against each phase is covered by the reference validation tests where the rules are modelled. The share of the kill spent on each phase is an assumption; compare the per-phase DPS figures. Blood Moon, Blue Moon, Eclipse Moon have special damage rules that are not modelled, so DPS is an estimate. Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.
warnings: One setup for all three Moons. Each Moon's special phase is not modelled.
Only melee is offered: the Moons have very high ranged and magic defence.
Phase weights are assumptions; compare the per-phase DPS figures rather than only the weighted total.

strategies.name: Melee
strategies.description: Melee setup for the whole fight.
